name: Download page lists every platform with mirror links and checksums

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/download.html and wait for the page to load
Download links for Muster.dmg, Muster-intel.dmg, Muster-setup.exe, Muster.deb and Muster.AppImage are present and point at https://muster.orazen.online/downloads/
SHA256 checksums or a checksums file link is shown for at least one platform
A Docker / self-host section with instructions or a command is visible
The page states the current version number somewhere (e.g. 1.7.0 or a version badge)
